title: How Does Post-Training Shape LLM Value Preferences?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During post-training, large language models (LLMs) learn value preferences from corpora that may contain imbalanced proportions of opinions associated with different demographic groups. Amplifying these imbalances may further underrepresent some groups' opinions. However, how opinion mixtures shape value preferences across post-training paths remains unclear. To answer this question, we conduct controlled experiments using post-training corpora with different opinion mixtures and five post-training paths based on SFT, DPO, and GRPO. We find that post-training amplifies opinion imbalances differently across post-training paths. Once value preferences are amplified, whether further post-training can remove them depends on both the post-training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus. translated_title: 后训练如何塑造大语言模型的价值偏好？
translated_abstract: 在后训练过程中，大语言模型（LLM）会从语料库中学习价值偏好，而这些语料库中与不同人群相关的观点比例可能是不平衡的。放大这种不平衡可能会进一步导致某些群体的观点代表性不足。然而，观点混合比例如何在不同后训练路径中塑造价值偏好，目前仍不清楚。为了回答这个问题，我们使用包含不同观点混合比例的后训练语料库，以及基于SFT、DPO和GRPO的五种后训练路径，进行了受控实验。我们发现，不同的后训练路径对观点不平衡的放大程度各不相同。一旦价值偏好被放大，后续的后训练能否消除这种放大，既取决于后训练方法，也取决于语料库中的观点混合比例。更令人担忧的是，模型在干预下的稳定性取决于后续后训练是否改变其价值偏好。此外，这些价值……
tldr: 该论文通过受控实验发现，SFT、DPO、GRPO等不同后训练路径会以不同方式放大语料库中的观点不平衡，而被放大的价值偏好能否通过后续后训练消除，取决于训练方法与语料中的观点构成。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts controlled experiments showing that different post-training paths (SFT, DPO, GRPO) amplify corpus opinion imbalances in distinct ways, and whether amplified value preferences can be removed by further post-training depends on both the training method and the opinion mixture in the corpus.
